project.description: $MOW — One Loud Cat Running Ethereum on Robinhood ChainRaw meme power. Community-run. Gloriously useless in the best way possible.No roadmap. No VCs. No whitepaper. Just a loud cat that showed up in a parking lot, sat on the keyboard, and refused to leave the trading desk.Every green candle gets announced at 4 AM at full volume. The chart hears it.1,000,000,000 supply • 0/0 tax • Pure chaos on Robinhood ChainFeed the Mow. Drop the Ball. Be loud.
